_comment: Merge into <home>/.claude/settings.json (Windows: C:\Users\<u>\.claude\settings.json). Replace {{NODE_EXE}} with the absolute node executable (process.execPath; e.g. C:\Users\<u>\tools\node22\node.exe) and {{OFFICE_HOOK}} with the absolute path of adapters/claude-code/office-hook.mjs. This is the EXEC FORM (command + args): no shell is involved, so paths with spaces and backslashes are passed verbatim — required on Windows, valid on macOS/Linux too. Set OFFICE_CONFIG (or OFFICE_ENDPOINT + OFFICE_INGEST_KEY) in the environment. Events carry whitelisted metadata only — never prompts or tool I/O.
